`baffled-screenshots.js` is copied with a provenance header from
`dom767/ScreenGrabber`, `sdk/baffled-screenshots.js`. The header records the
ScreenGrabber commit it came from.

ScreenGrabber owns this SDK; don't edit it here. The export pulls it again from
`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dom767/ScreenGrabber/master/sdk/baffled-screenshots.js`
before bundling and fails if it can't (`scripts/refresh-screengrabber-sdk.mjs`,
see `deploy.md`). Commit the file when an export refreshes it. The checked-in
copy is what source development runs.
